title: Optimal large sieve for fixed order characters
summary: Let $n \geq 3$. We improve the large sieve inequality for $n$-th order Hecke characters over any number field containing the $n$-th roots of unity. Our bound is expected to be optimal in all ranges of parameters. Several applications are deduced, including a tight upper bound for the second moment of cubic characters ordered by conductor, asymptotics with lower order terms for the cubic second moment over squarefree moduli, and improved moment and zero density estimates for every $n \geq 3$.
